correctness.rationale: The exact rank-one trace identity reduces the 2d-by-2d kernel to a symmetric off-diagonal block; singular-value decomposition gives all eigenvalues. For doubly stochastic overlaps, row/column sum inequalities and the strict concavity of fractional powers establish the sign and sharp extremal bound. Connected components are square doubly stochastic blocks, whose Perron singular value at exponent one is simple. Its derivative equals negative mean component Shannon entropy. Taking a finite maximum proves the one-sided spectral slopes, nullities and near-critical inertia. The standalone diagnostic passed 2262 assertions but is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The operator-algebraic trace kernel is naturally motivated by a recent sharp 3-point positivity theorem and its order-four obstruction. Classifying the entire two-basis family gives exact positivity and nullity boundaries, while the componentwise Shannon-entropy cusp determines how obstruction appears at the Hilbert–Schmidt exponent and how many negative directions emerge. These exact finite invariants distinguish reducible and mutually unbiased overlap geometries; their motivation precedes computation and does not depend on promising unproved downstream applications.
